subject: Re: NimbusHealth - context length & token volume profiling / pricing next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: NimbusHealth discovery - context-length & pricing follow-up

Hi Samir / Lara,

Thanks again for the time today - really helpful to see how Nimbus is using long-form clinical summaries and patient Q&A. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we're aligned on pricing inputs: 

Summary of needs (from today)
- Primary workload: patient-facing Q&A + automated discharge summaries.
- Typical sessions will be 1\u20132 user prompts followed by 1 generated completion; occasionally multi-turn back-and-forth.
- Context distribution: most calls need 8k+, many require 32k for concatenated notes, and rare archival retrievals may need 128k.
- Security requirement: PHI in transit, you mentioned SOC2 + BAA in scope.

Initial token profile ask (what we need to estimate pricing)
- Representative sample: ~100 recent conversation transcripts (de-identified OK) or a CSV with per-session prompt_tokens & completion_tokens.
- A note on percent of calls by context-length (approx): % for 8k, 32k, 128k.

High level unit-econ framing we discussed
- You indicated a target cost range of roughly $250-$350 per 1M tokens for production inference (target USD/1M tokens).
- We ran a quick back-of-envelope today: if avg session = 300 prompt + 700 completion = ~1k tokens, 1M sessions = 1B tokens -> we'll refine with your samples.

Proposed next steps
1) You share the sample CSV (template attached) or 100 transcripts.
2) Dev will run a token-profile and context-length classification (8k/32k/128k buckets) and return a per-bucket monthly cost estimate at different $/1M tiers (we'll show $200 / $300 / $400).
3) Schedule 30m to review numbers and talk POC scope - I'm proposing Mon 4/20 or Tue 4/21.

Attachments: nimbus_token_profile_template.csv (simple per-session rows: session_id, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, context_bucket)

Thanks - I'll queue up the profiling once we have the sample.

Best,
Marissa Cole

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 13:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: NimbusHealth discovery - context-length & pricing follow-up

Marissa - thanks for the summary and clear next steps. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Volume & sessions
- We're planning an initial rollout to ~50k MAU (customer portal users) with an expected 200k sessions/month (we count session = single user interaction that may include a prompt + one completion).

2) Token profile (rough averages from instrumentation)
- Avg prompt_tokens: 250 (user questions + brief context)
- Avg completion_tokens: 750 (model-generated explanation / summary)
- So average per-session = ~1,000 tokens.

3) Context-length breakdown (estimated)
- ~70% of calls fit within 8k context (short visit notes + question)
- ~25% require 32k (multi-note concatenation, extended history)
- ~5% require 128k (full medical record retrieval / long legal text)

4) Budget & target unit economics
- Our procurement and finance are looking for pricing in the range of $200-$300 / 1M tokens for the initial committed volume; they are comfortable with a ramp with discounts for committed reserved capacity.
- Rough budget target for first 3 months: $20k-$40k / month (we know this is an approximation - exact depends on final token counts and SLAs).

I've attached 100 de-identified session transcripts (nimbus_sample_convos_100.csv). Let us know if you need more or in a different format.

Thanks - Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Product, NimbusHealth
samir.patel@nimbushealth.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbushealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: NimbusHealth discovery - profiling plan & cost examples

Thanks Samir - got the CSV and the quick numbers are helpful. I dug into a quick test run and here's a concrete plan and example math so finance can see how units translate to cost.

Profiling & deliverables
- What we'll run: token histogram, per-session avg prompt/completion, context_bucket tagging (8k/32k/128k), and percentile analysis (P50/P90/P99 token lengths).
- Deliverables: CSV with per-bucket token counts, projected monthly tokens (based on your 200k sessions/mo), and cost table at three price points ($200 / $275 / $350 per 1M tokens).

Example unit-econ math (using your averages)
- Sessions / month: 200,000
- Avg tokens / session: 1,000 => total tokens = 200M tokens / month
- Cost at $200 / 1M = (200M / 1M) * $200 = $40,000 / month
- Cost at $275 / 1M = $55,000 / month
- Cost at $350 / 1M = $70,000 / month

Context sensitivity (because longer context increases memory & serving cost per token slightly)
- We'll show an adjusted table that accounts for 8k/32k/128k call mix. For example, the 5% 128k calls often increase average latency and may drive a small surcharge in dedicated scenarios; we'll flag that and show a per-bucket expected QPS and recommended serving profile.

POC suggestion
- 2-week profiling run (no charge) where we run token breakdowns and a small performance test on a mirrored dataset.
- After profiling: we'll produce an estimate and recommended reserved capacity option (if you want consistent p99 latency) vs. hosted on-demand pricing.

Next steps
1) We'll run profiling on the CSV you attached (I've started processing).
2) Can we set the review call for Tue 4/21 10:00-10:30 PT? Marissa - can you send a calendar invite?

Note: We'll also include a simple sensitivity table to show how changes in avg completion length affect monthly cost (e.g., +200 completion tokens = +40% cost).

Dev
